name: DreamGen
summary: Structured, multi-character roleplay and writing: world definitions, plot direction, and scenario control. More writing desk than phone companion — the public scenario library is SFW-only, with mature themes reserved for private scenarios.
ranking_rationale: Pricing page and vendor docs verify the $7.83 Starter monthly rate (20%-off intro $6.26), a documented free tier with a message and image allowance, and a 5K/15K/30K context ladder. Verified as active as of 2026-10-27. Ranks as the narrative-control pick: no TTS and a first-plan 5,000-token window hold it back.
